blueprints.name: idea-to-spec
blueprints.description: Transform a raw idea into a structured feature spec with research, integration analysis, and validation.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: spec-to-feature
blueprints.description: Transforms a structured feature spec (T-*.md format) into a production-ready feature scaffold with file structure, risk assessment, and decomposed tasks.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: tdd-bug-hunter
blueprints.description: Adversarial TDD loop: write failing test → fix → verify → repeat until dry
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: adversarial-review
blueprints.description: Multi-perspective code review with N independent refuters — only surviving findings are reported
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: ci-polling
blueprints.description: Polls CI status, extracts failure logs, applies auto-fix, loops until green
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: deploy-verify
blueprints.description: Post-deploy health polling loop with smoke tests and optional auto-rollback
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: brainstorming-premortem
blueprints.description: Multi-angle idea generation followed by adversarial pre-mortem: surfaces risks before committing to a plan
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: pre-push-cohesion-check
blueprints.description: Validates consistency across OSS repos before pushing: README, CHANGELOG, schemas, naming, scrub anti-leak
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: self-skill-improvement
blueprints.description: Reads a SKILL.md via deterministic tool step, analyzes quality, proposes improvements, adversarial review decides ACCEPT or KEEP
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: conductor-loop-improvement
blueprints.description: Audits and improves the loop configuration of an existing conductor blueprint — surfaces infinite loop risks and unclear exit conditions
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: onboarding-external
blueprints.description: Simulates the complete onboarding journey for an external user discovering conductor, installing blueprints, and submitting their own. Validates UX fluidity end-to-end.
blueprints.author: SolFoundy

blueprints.name: docs-sync
blueprints.description: Automates CHANGELOG, README, and roadmap updates after releases using git log and GitHub issue tracking.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys

blueprints.name: fetch-web
blueprints.description: Deterministic web fetching pipeline with LLM synthesis. RAG-first: checks local cache before fetching. Tools handle HTTP, LLM handles analysis.
blueprints.author: SolSolis-Sys
